name: io.github.slabbdev/navette
title: navette — the browser for agents
description: One tiny Rust binary driving the WebView your OS already ships (WKWebView, WebView2, WebKitGTK) — no Chromium, no download. 16 MCP tools: navigate, read, screenshot, click, hover, type, key, evaluate, wait, scroll, upload, viewport, sessions, session_close, state_export, state_import.
